[chlodna_glowa].description.t: Screaming and blood all around, and you think as clearly as an innkeeper totting up a bill.

[cyrulik].description.t: You'll stitch a wound, bind it and pull a tooth while you're at it, and the patient hardly screams.

[czuly_na_swiat].description.t: You feel something quiver in the air, and this time it isn't the beer.

[czytanie_walki].description.t: The enemy hasn't even swung yet, and you already know he'll miss.

[finta].description.t: You make as if to go left, then strike right, and nobody's caught on yet.

[gadane].description.t: You can talk anyone round, even a smith who happens to have a hammer in his hand.

[kocie_zycie].description.t: You always land on all four paws, and when you don't, you run for it quick.

[kupiecka_zylka].description.t: You can smell a groat from the far end of the market, and nobody ever palms junk off on you.

[lekki_krok].description.t: You dance better in a fight than at a wedding, only with fewer drunks.

[nieugiety].description.t: Take a blow to the head and you'll still stay on your feet, just with a surprised look on your face.

[pewna_reka].description.t: Whatever you throw or shoot usually goes where you meant it to.

[pewny_chwyt].description.t: Once you grab hold, nothing slips from your grip, be it a weapon or a tankard.

[sokole_oko].description.t: You'll hit a fly in the mouth at fifty paces, as long as it holds still.

[szczesciarz].description.t: Fortune smiles on you, though likely for want of better company.

[szkola_miecza].description.t: The drillmaster beat it into your skull how to swing a blade, and some of it even stuck.

[szkola_wloczni].description.t: You know how to keep the enemy at the end of the shaft, and how not to get skewered yourself.

[szybkie_nogi].description.t: Courage is all well and good, but you'll still be first to reach the woods.

[twarda_reka].description.t: You hit so hard that even the enemy admits it hurt.

[twarda_skora].description.t: It's easier to break a stick over you than your bones.

[unik].description.t: When someone swings, you just happen not to be there.

[wol_roboczy].description.t: You haul enough for two and complain enough for three.
